map.：算法：综合评分 = 类型评分×0.3 + 规模评分×0.2 + 完整度评分×0: : Algorithm: composite score = type score×0.3 + scale score×0.2 + integrity score×0.2 + scientific value score×0.3. The scale score is banded by area (>10→5, >1→4, >0.1→3, otherwise 2), integrity score = integrity%/20, scientific value score is 0–5. Grades: ≥4.2 Level 1 national, ≥3.6 Level 2 provincial, ≥2.8 Level 3 municipal, ≥2.0 Level 4 county, otherwise Level 5 general (computed locally, not uploaded).
